nodes.label: /graphify add <url>
nodes.rationale: Fetches a URL (YouTube/video, Twitter/X, arXiv, PDF, image, or generic webpage), saves it into ./raw with detected type-specific handling, then runs --update to merge it into the existing graph.

nodes.label: --watch folder watcher
nodes.rationale: Debounces file-change bursts (default 3s) so a wave of parallel agent writes doesn't trigger a rebuild per file; code changes rebuild automatically with no LLM, doc/image changes just flag needs_update for a manual --update.
